title: RayCast2D ignores CollisionShape2D when moved without its StaticBody2D parent
body:
### Tested versions

v4.4.1.stable.official [49a5bc7b6]

### System information

Godot v4.4.1.stable - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Mobile) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.7640) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-4790 CPU @ 3.60GHz (8 threads)

### Issue description

In the editor, the CollisionShape2D triggers RayCast2Ds in its original position, but is ignored by those positioned some distance away from its original position relative to the parent StaticBody2D when only it is moved there, without the parent. 

The "some distance" is possibly given by leaving the area formed by the CollisionShape2D when it was last moved by the parent, or some "check for collision" rect around there. Moving the StaticBody2D works exactly as expected and all RayCast2Ds react correctly.

### Steps to reproduce

Setup RayCast2Ds in parallel and in a tool script, force them to update in process so they display color changes when intersected.
Move a StaticBody2D with a CollisionShape2D through them and see them react.
Move only the CollisionShape2D and see none or only those around the original position react.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[worldle.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/21804778/worldle.zip)
